integrity: Exact theorem follows from the backward transform, conditional expectation identities, derivative factorization and asymptotic expansions. Numerical finite checks are supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one angular wall-binding episode with constant exponential killing and unbiased rotational diffusion, not to whole-channel returns, nonexponential killing or angular drift. Other Brownian exit literature could contain an equivalent formulation.
title: Unique event-time reversal for angular escape versus absorption at a sticky active wall
